paragraphs: You have made it to the last page — patience like that deserves a good engineer. Let me introduce one.

For 13+ years I've built systems that must be right and on time: 25M+ records matched before a 30-minute deadline, $1M+ a day of banking at 99.99% accuracy, and software running on 50,000+ devices around the world.

Ownership from the first design doc to the 2 a.m. alert.
AI in my toolkit, judgement in my hands.
